purpose: Small supervised adaptation pilot for English-to-Korean financial educational prose.

authorship.english: Independently composed by the assistant for this pilot.
authorship.korean: Translated and edited by the same assistant; not a user-reviewed or professional reference translation.

files.use: Checkpoint/model selection and general-language retention gating only; never include in gradient updates.

glossary.annotation: Actual English span and its Korean target; longer overlapping phrases take precedence. This is terminology annotation, not a separate set of sentence references.

conceptSources.use: Concepts of financial statements; the short verified chapter title is used in one independently written sentence.
Time value of money concepts, not copied sentence pairs.
English financial terminology and conceptual distinctions.
Definitions and relationships among financial ratios.
Firm cash flow and continuing business valuation concepts.
Distinction between intrinsic valuation assumptions and market price.

splitPolicy.train: 160 finance sentences from 8 concept areas; 40 independent general-language retention examples.
splitPolicy.dev: 30 finance audit, document reconciliation, and reviewer-comment contexts plus 10 independently composed general review, communication, and troubleshooting contexts; not shuffled numeric substitutions of training examples.
splitPolicy.test: Assigned to a separate author without reading train/dev sentences. Test content and metadata are maintained separately.
splitPolicy.similarityMethod: Lowercase English word sets; numeric sequences replaced by #; Jaccard intersection/union. This check cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence.
splitPolicy.contaminationLimit: Synthetic data can share common financial concepts and writing habits. No claim that the base model has never seen similar concepts or sentences.

qualityChecks.financeConceptReview: Assistant review for meaning, conditions, negation, time basis, and equity/firm claim distinctions; not independent expert review.
qualityChecks.numericExamples: Invented illustrative amounts; not historical company data. Digits, percentages, and explicit currency codes are preserved.
qualityChecks.modelPerformance: Not assessed by dataset creation. Baseline and tuned models must be evaluated separately; improvement is not guaranteed.

rightsAndAccess.dataset: Assistant-authored synthetic adaptation examples. No separate redistribution license is assigned by this metadata.
rightsAndAccess.conceptReferences: Source URLs establish conceptual provenance; they do not imply that source publishers created, approved, translated, or licensed this dataset.

excludedExternalCandidates.scope: Official page: 1.5 million paired sentences overall; finance/stocks category 200,000.
excludedExternalCandidates.access: Domestic-user application and download approval required. Not downloaded; no account action taken.
excludedExternalCandidates.license: Check dataset approval conditions and supplied license before ingestion; no CC0 claim.

excludedExternalCandidates.scope: Official target table: 1.5 million overall; economics 300,000 including finance 68,000. Actual delivered finance count not verified.
excludedExternalCandidates.access: Domestic-user application and download approval required. Not downloaded.
excludedExternalCandidates.license: Schema contains per-record source and license fields. Their actual values were not obtained.

excludedExternalCandidates.scope: 2026-01-29 Korean economics/finance glossary, 800 entries; not confirmed as an English-Korean parallel sentence corpus.
excludedExternalCandidates.access: Public landing page and downloadable PDF; not downloaded for training.
excludedExternalCandidates.license: BOK copyright policy distinguishes designated public data from other website information. No training permission inferred from public access.

excludedExternalCandidates.scope: English report released 2025-04-24 explicitly identifies itself as translation of Korean report published 2025-03-13. Sentence alignment not performed.
excludedExternalCandidates.access: Public report page; not downloaded for training.
excludedExternalCandidates.license: Same BOK copyright-policy check would be required; not assumed open training data.
